cases.situation: A 100000-loop rail repeats a small semantic state space.
Profession, experience or urgency labels do not change stimulus, path or oracle.
A browser journey renders the right labels and the release wants to claim novice comprehension.
AI OFF is stored in browser localStorage but direct AI endpoints still accept calls.
The UI promises ten files of 5 MiB each over an 8 MB JSON transport.
Novice routing says the selected file is preserved but only filename is routed.
Static HTML exposes legacy Home Monitoring Events and JavaScript rewrites it to V4.
TLS backup durable storage and accessibility are marked verified only because environment flags are set.
The store hard-stops after ten thousand audit events.
Each mutation rewrites a state snapshot containing the entire growing audit history.
README describes two governed processes while runtime contract exposes seven.
A security workflow is skipped while other checks pass.
The builder authored generator oracle and release attestation for a high-risk runtime change.
The product is internally stable but no real-user comprehension study exists.
